why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate rose 0.81%; desktop moved +0.84% and mobile +0.07%, but neither cut is clear on its own, so the split is unproven.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Ad Click Rate fell 2.8%, an unregistered secondary; Revenue per User held at -0.10%.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: The mechanism is unknown; the ranker may surface the answer sooner, so fewer ad clicks follow.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison showing the arms already differed on Successful Search Rate would void this result, since the test would be broken.
A daily series by days since first exposure showing the lift fading would mean the test needs more time.
Revenue per User falling past its 1% margin on a longer window would block the release.
